text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "posts.LastEditorUserId is a user identifier (note the -1 community placeholder and the users it implies), while postHistory.Id is the primary key of revision-event rows, and the high containment is coincidental because postHistory.Id densely covers integers 1–386,848, which happens to include nearly all user IDs up to ~55,733 (coverage is only 1.9%, and postHistory has its own UserId column for user references)."}
